comments.author: PotatoAim
comments.body_html:
There seems to be an error with the Parent ID of the food/drink items in this mod: they are set to “5448f3ac4bdc2dce718b4569” which is Medical, instead of Food [5448e8d04bdc2ddf718b4569] or Drink [5448e8d64bdc2dce718b4568].

However, if you change the parent IDs to the proper food/drink, you are unable to use any food/drink items. There are also several errors in the food/drink items because they contain entries like “medusetime” instead of “foodusetime”

comments.author: Sneaky_Weasel
comments.body_html:
Hi all. I’ve tidied up code and fixed the bags issue. Seeing as I also had a similar mod for medical items I’ve released this as an All-In-One. You can enable different components via config file, if you don’t like med changes for example. It’s over at Sneaky Weasel’s All-In-One Meds & Food

If possible I recommend changing to that one as it’s easier for me to fix issues in one place Thanks so much for your feedback and your patience.
